newsitem.title: USA: GT Global says two funds held Bre-X shrs.
newsitem.headline: GT Global says two funds held Bre-X shrs.

text.p: GT Global, a mutual fund company that is part of Liechtenstein Global Trust, said on Thursday that two of its funds held shares of Bre-X Minerals Ltd, which fell sharply in value today.
GT Global Natural Resources fund and GT Global Variable Natural Resources Fund's respective interests in Bre-X amounted to 2.5 and 2.71 percent of fund assets, before the stock plunged.

When trading resumed after the company revealed that it may have overstated the value of a prospective gold mining project in Indonesia, the stock fell more than 9 points to 1-31/32 on the Nasdaq market.
Following the suspension, consistent with established pricing procedures, each fund valued its Bre-X holdings at C$1.00 per share at close of business March 26, 1997.
Based on that valuation, Bre-X Minerals Ltd. represents 0.16 percent and 0.18 percent, respectively, of GT Global Natural Resources Fund and GT Global Variable Natural Resources Fund.
